about: Written on 2026-10-23 by a Claude agent asked only to label data, before any AI-answer sentiment classifier existed and without reading any classifier code: the 70 hold-out cases (H) were written from scratch, with invented business names for every criticism, and the 40 real cases (R) are sentences from AI answers stored in harness/fixtures_live, kept verbatim or lightly trimmed. Polarity is about the named business only: a stated official accreditation, approval or certification counts as trust positive, a plain list item or description is neutral, and a mixed statement takes the side a buyer would take away (usually the clause after 'but'). An aspect with polarity 'neutral' marks a dimension the text describes without judging; the stored real answers contain no criticism of a named business, so the negative class is covered by the hold-out only.

cases.text:
### 1. InvoiceNow Biz
A fully Ministry of Finance (MoF) accredited e-invoicing service provider operating its own specialized `eInvoiceXchange` platform. It offers end-to-end integration, consulting, and free introductory tiers for testing and piloting.
cases.note: full accreditation, end-to-end integration and free tiers

cases.text:
### 2. ClearTax
An AI-native compliance technology platform. It is recognized as one of the prominent fully approved ASPs in the UAE, providing real-time data validation and integration for enterprise accounting systems.
cases.note: 'recognized as one of the prominent fully approved ASPs'

cases.text:
### 3. EDICOM
A global EDI and electronic invoicing platform officially accredited by the UAE Ministry of Finance. EDICOM assists large-scale and multinational enterprises with continuous transaction controls (CTC) and Peppol standard integration.
cases.note: official accreditation; the rest describes its customers and services

cases.text:
### 4. SunTec Business Solutions
An accredited service provider listed on the FTA EmaraTax portal. SunTec's *Xelerate E-Invoicing* software helps UAE businesses automate their compliance operations, manage high-volume invoice routing, and avoid tax penalties.
cases.note: accreditation plus benefits stated favourably

cases.text:
### 5. Complyance.io
Complyance acts as a dedicated middleware service, integrating POS, billing systems, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems directly with tax authorities via the Peppol network.
cases.note: describes what the service connects; no evaluation or credential

cases.text:
### 6. Business Experts MEA (BEMEA)
An enterprise IT consulting and systems integrator specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365. BEMEA assists UAE organizations with their e-invoicing strategy, connecting internal ERP architectures with approved ASP networks for smooth tax clearance.
cases.note: descriptive; 'smooth tax clearance' is the purpose of the service, not a judgement of BEMEA
